_comment: rsi_zone phased grid. Phase 1 (entry) sweeps the RSI length and the lower critical band whose DOWNWARD cross opens the trade. Phase 2 (trend) sweeps the single trend EMA the close must sit above. Phase 3 (exit) sweeps the upper critical band whose UPWARD cross closes the trade. Phase 4 (risk) sweeps the stop in daily ATR; 0 (no stop) is deliberately absent - a multi-day long without a stop is not a point calibration may pick. DailyATRPeriod stays at its default and is NOT swept. RunPhases expands each phase over the previous phase's keepTop survivors: 15 + 5x4 + 5x6 + 5x4 = 85 combos. Judge on pooled OOS profit factor from a walk-forward, never on the in-sample best.
